text:
Asha: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-picker tweak, some Mixtral configs show 5-12% P99 token latency regressions at seq=1024 when KV cache warmup hits. Attached profile: /s3/profiles/mixtral/kp-regen-1777777777.pb
Ben: Which kernel-picker flag did we flip? Was it the heuristics for head_dim != kv_dim fallback?
Asha: flipped `enable_kernel_type_bias = true` and lowered `batch_threshold_ms` from 6 -> 4. Observed more kernel switches mid-conversation causing KV cache invalidation. Logs show `KV_CACHE_SHARD_MIGRATE` events.
Casey: Oof. We saw similar on Qwen where RoPE scaling triggers a different kernel path. If a single request crosses the cutoff, the runtime picks fallback kernel and we lose continuous batching.
Asha: Exact. Here's a trace snippet:
```
[trace] convo_id=abc123: seq=512 -> 1024 transition
kernel_select: fast_attn (head_dim=64) -> fallback_attn_byte (head_dim=32)
KV_ACTION: invalidate_shard shard=7
```
Ben: So tokenizer impact too? Might be chat templates injecting extra special tokens causing seq bump.
Asha: Yes — noticed system prompt with trailing newline + role token doubled BOS -> +4 tokens.
Casey: Actionable steps:
- revert `batch_threshold_ms` to 6 for Mixtral pools
- add a guard to kernel-picker to avoid switching kernels within a conversation if KV warmup ratio > 0.6
- add tokenizer normalization for chat templates to strip unnecessary role tokens
Marco: I'll run a quick perf A/B on dedicated pool with `--no-kernel-switch-during-kv-warmup` flag.
infra-bot: Deploy started for pool mixtral-dedicated-3 by Marco. (deploy id: dpl-889)
Ben: Also consider keeping kernel variant compatibility table keyed by (model, head_dim, kv_dim, rope_freq). If incompatible, route to stable variant instead of switching.
Asha: Agree. Also need to add metric `kernel_switch_rate_per_convo` to console traces. Right now we only have global switches.
Casey: Small PR for tokenizer: trim double-BOS in chat template, and normalize trailing spaces. I'll open it and assign to @Ben for review.
Ben: Reviewing. If we can keep switches under 1% and avoid KV invalidations, P99 should come down.
Asha: TL;DR: revert threshold, add guard, tokenizer normalization, add kernel_switch metric. I'll file tickets.
Marco: Thanks. Will report perf after deploy (expected ~15m). :thumbsup:
